note: The bands the Ugly Stik plant has to land in, from docs/UGLYSTIK-STAGE1.md, which derives each from RCM's published Das Ugly Stik (plan 939, May and June 1985: its data table, its travel limits and the full size plan, measured), O.S.'s figures for the 61FX, an owner's tachometer and APC's propeller data (scripts/uglystik-derive.js prints the derived figures). Set from the derivation before the plant was flown. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

u1_level_75.source: level speed at three quarter throttle, the trim RCM's pilot cranked in, derived 22.36, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e), was 17.33 on the straight line; the band 15 percent either side, the Edge's

u2_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 9.48; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 0.95 / 4.824; the band the Edge's in proportion, 6 percent under and 14 over Re-derived 2026-10-11: alphaStall over the wing's own slope, a_w 4.427 (scripts/uglystik-derive.js), not the wing and tail's 4.824: the stall angle is the wing's and the tail's share lifts on past it, as the Extra's (#935); was 0.19693. And the band with it: the plant's CLmax is the wing's 0.950 plus the tail's share at that angle, (CLa - a_w) sin a cos a = 0.083, so the formula's speeds go by sqrt(0.950 / 1.033) = 0.9592.

u3_glide.source: L/D at 1.4 Vs, 13.27 m/s, derived 7.38; the band 11 percent either side, the Edge's

u4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 28.29 (re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e), was 22.10 on the straight line), 10 percent either side

u5_climb.source: the best climb at a held airspeed, full throttle, derived 12.34 m/s at 16.0 (re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e), was 7.68 at 12.0 on the straight line), the sweep moved with the best speed, 1 under it to 4 over as it was; 30 percent under and 20 over, the Kadet's in proportion. RCM: 'lots of straight up capability'

u6_roll.source: full aileron at RCM's travel limits (5/16 in up, 1/4 in down, on the 1.29 in strip aileron) from level flight at the trim, as the helix angle: Clda over -Clp times the mean throw, derived 0.0748 (122 deg/s at the 22.4 m/s trim, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e); 95 deg/s at 17.3 m/s on the straight line); 20 percent either side, the Edge's

u7_axial.source: a whole aileron roll from level at the trim, the elevator and the rudder centred, the pilot's hands off every other stick: the sideslip under 1.5 times the linear model's peak over the first quarter, 4.75 deg at the 22.36 m/s trim (re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e), was 7.67 at 17.33 m/s on the straight line): the aircraft turns about its own axis rather than yawing off it (the bellcranks' differential). The nose's ground heading is printed and not held: its first band, 15 deg, was set with no reference behind it, and hands off the path dives 36 m through the roll, so a steep nose's ground projection swings and the number read the dive, not the axis (docs/UGLYSTIK-STAGE1.md)

u8_inverted.source: a section within a percent of symmetric at half a degree of incidence: on its back at three quarter throttle it flies within 5 percent of its upright speed, stalls within 6 percent of its upright stall speed and rolls within 5 percent of its upright rate, the Edge's bands; and holds level with a push, derived 3.06 deg of down elevator, 0.323 of the stick through the expo on RCM's 3/8 in of travel, 30 percent either side (re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e): the trim moved to 22.36 m/s and with it Cm0, 0.0281 to 0.0166; it was 5.0 deg and 0.50 of the stick)

u9_loop.source: flown since 2026-10-11 with the wings and the nose held in the loop's plane on the ailerons and rudder as a pilot holds them (tests/lib/wingpilot.js loopHold): with them centred the prop's torque and swirl at the loop's speed, taken from APC's Cp since then (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md), turned it 24 deg out of its plane, a lateral premise the longitudinal derivation below never had; re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e) and its Cm0: 43.63 m up and 36.96 m along, 19.69 m/s over the top, out 6.35 m under, the same tolerances about them; before that, with the prop's wash over the tail in the whole equations (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md): 35.49 m up and 28.14 m along, 13.34 m/s over the top, out 8.59 m under; before the wash: half up stick held at full throttle from level at the full throttle speed, the ailerons and the rudder centred, on the plant's longitudinal equations integrated whole (scripts/uglystik-derive.js loopWhole): 41.35 m up and 32.56 m along, 13.55 m/s over the top, and out 4.52 m under its entry, 11 percent of its height; the plant's within 15 percent of each, out within 3 m of the derived exit, and straight: the heading within 15 deg and the wings within 15 deg of level over the top and out of it. The first bands were a point mass's that trims its angle of attack at once (44.6 m, 32.6 m, 13.3 m/s, out 0.9 m under): the plant came out 4.6 m under, outside the exit's band, and the whole equations, the short period's lag included, account for it to 0.1 m (docs/UGLYSTIK-STAGE1.md)

u10_neutral.source: from level at the trim rolled to 30 deg, every stick let go: the lateral model's spiral root is -0.028 at the 22.36 m/s trim, a half life of 25 s, so it holds its bank, 24.9 deg after 6 s (re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e): -0.015, 46 s and 26.6 deg at 17.33 m/s on the straight line); the band the Kadet's in proportion, 0.451 to 1.316 of it. RCM: 'it goes where you point it until you tell it differently, no hands off inherent stability like a J-3 Cub'

u11_stall_power_off.source: full up held from level at 1.2 Vs with the throttle closed, the ailerons and rudder centred: a straight, untwisted wing whose thick section stalls from the trailing edge drops its nose and no wing, the Kadet's S9 bands The yaw limit is re-derived 2026-10-11 from a spin's definition, autorotation: with the wings inside the bank limit the aircraft only turns, at g tan(bank) / V, so the limit is the turn that bank allows at the mush's measured speed (tests/lib/wingpilot.js turnYawLimitDeg, docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md), where it was 20 deg/s with no source.

u11_stall_power_on.source: the same at half throttle with the wings held on the ailerons, as a pilot does: no roll rate past 20 deg/s, a wing drop's signature (the P-51's is 20 deg/s, docs/P51-STAGE1.md), and under half the aileron on average to hold them. Its first form, hands off the ailerons, read 22.6 deg of bank after 10 s: the prop's 0.21 N m rolling the stalled aircraft left at 2 deg/s, a slow torque roll with no break, recorded in docs/UGLYSTIK-STAGE1.md. 2026-10-08 (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md, the stall part 1): the ailerons' hold given an integral, as the Kadet's S8: the torque and swirl are a steady moment a proportional hold leaves as a steady bank. The bands are as they were. The yaw limit is re-derived 2026-10-11 from a spin's definition, autorotation: with the wings inside the bank limit the aircraft only turns, at g tan(bank) / V, so the limit is the turn that bank allows at the mush's measured speed (tests/lib/wingpilot.js turnYawLimitDeg, docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md), where it was 20 deg/s with no source.

u12_prop_torque.source: static full throttle, rolling left: APC's 0.612 N m for the 12 x 6 at 10,895 rpm, the engine's own torque, 15 percent either side

u13_phugoid.source: the phugoid at the trim on the linear longitudinal model, derived 29.48 s, zeta 0.81 (re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e) and its Cm0, trimmed at 22.36 m/s: was 14.91 s, zeta 0.54, at 17.33 m/s on the straight line); 18 percent either side, the Kadet's

u14_rest.source: the drawn model at rest, idling: the plan's mains reach 0.31 in lower than its nose wheel, 1.48 deg nose down with the CG 0.2025 m up, and the idle's thrust held by the wheels leans it onto the nose wheel, derived -1.86 deg and 13.2 percent on the nose

u15_takeoff.source: full throttle from standing on grass, the heading held on the rudder and the nose wheel, rotated at 1.2 Vs to 8 deg: derived rolls to 1.1 and 1.5 Vs, 5.1 m at 10.4 m/s and 10.5 m at 14.2 (re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e), was 6.3 m and 14.8 m on the straight line)

u16_landing.source: a glide at idle, a flare, and on the wheels the elevator let go: at rest on three wheels within 1.5 deg of U14, no hull or prop

u17_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash and every other aircraft's recorded flight hash in Node, from main's module at 71c0cbc, before the Ugly Stik existed; the Edge and the Extra left the list when they were removed on 2026-09-29 Re-pinned for the prop's slipstream and its gyroscope on every prop (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md): the recordings flown under power moved; the five inch's is as it was. Re-pinned 2026-10-12 (w36-p51-clmax): the P-51's two recorded flights (p51 was 7219c30ebb48a05c, p51-air 4646a1ba51f005db) moved with its stall taken from measured sections, stall_re and stall_round on its own table (docs/P51-STAGE1.md); this aircraft's own recordings are unmoved.

u18_cross_host.source: the Stik's recorded take off, roll, inverted run and loop, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome

u19_idle.source: the engine at O.S.'s 2,000 rpm idle keeps turning and its 1.22 N is under the 2.14 N the grass holds the aircraft with: it stands; the ground speed the Kadet's S20 band

u21_taxi.source: full right rudder at a walk: the wheelbase over tan of the nose wheel's 0.6 of the rudder's 14.6 deg, 0.300 / tan 8.78 deg, derived 1.94 m; 23 percent under and 29 over, the Edge's taxi band in proportion
